section: SEBI - establishment, powers and functions; investor protection and market regulation
subsections: Investor protection - IEPF, SCORES, insider trading and PFUTP
Commodity market regulation - Forward Markets Commission

accepted.s: The Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Authority functions under which of the following?
o: SEBI Act, 1992 and Ministry of Finance
Companies Act, 2013 and Ministry of Corporate Affairs
Forward Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1952 and Ministry of Commerce
Companies Act, 1956 and Ministry of Corporate Affairs
accepted.x: The IEPF Authority was established under the Companies Act, 2013 and functions under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct parent legislation and administrative ministry.
accepted.sec: Investor protection - IEPF, SCORES, insider trading and PFUTP

accepted.s: Which one of the following is a principal function of the IEPF Authority?
o: Refund of unclaimed dividends and shares and promotion of investor awareness
Settlement of stock exchange trades on a T+0 basis
accepted.x: The IEPF Authority promotes investor awareness and facilitates the refund of unclaimed dividends and shares.
accepted.tq: Match the institution with its specific investor-protection function.
accepted.sec: Investor protection - IEPF, SCORES, insider trading and PFUTP

accepted.s: SCORES, associated with investor protection in the securities market, is best described as:
o: An online complaints redress system of SEBI
A commodity futures exchange operated by NSE
A statutory fund for refunding unclaimed dividends
accepted.x: SCORES is SEBI’s online system for redressal of investor complaints.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a grievance-redress platform from regulatory funds and exchanges.
accepted.sec: Investor protection - IEPF, SCORES, insider trading and PFUTP

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The 2025 amendment to the PIT Regulations widened the scope of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information.
2. The PFUTP Regulations prohibit fraudulent and unfair trade practices.
3. The PIT Regulations and PFUTP Regulations are both associated with investor protection in the securities market.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The 2025 PIT amendment widened UPSI, while PFUTP Regulations address fraudulent and unfair trade practices; both support investor protection.
accepted.tq: Test the functions and relationship of closely related market-regulation regulations.
accepted.sec: Investor protection - IEPF, SCORES, insider trading and PFUTP

accepted.s: The 2025 amendment to the Insider Trading (PIT) Regulations is particularly associated with which change?
o: Replacing SEBI with the FMC as the securities regulator
accepted.x: The 2025 amendment to the Prevention of Insider Trading Regulations widened the scope of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information.
accepted.tq: Separate the specific amendment relating to UPSI from broader regulatory functions.
accepted.sec: Investor protection - IEPF, SCORES, insider trading and PFUTP

accepted.s:
Which of the following initiatives is correctly matched with its description?
1. New UPI address structure — facility for intermediaries
2. SEBI Check — investor-oriented tool
3. SEBI vs SCAM — investor-awareness campaign
4. Mission Jagrook — launched on SEBI’s 38th Foundation Day
accepted.x: All four pairs are correct. The initiatives include a new UPI address structure for intermediaries, SEBI Check, the SEBI vs SCAM campaign, and Mission Jagrook, which was launched on SEBI’s 38th Foundation Day.
accepted.tq: Use the complete-list option after verifying each investor-awareness initiative.
accepted.sec: Investor protection - IEPF, SCORES, insider trading and PFUTP

accepted.s: Mission Jagrook was launched on which occasion?
o: The 75th anniversary of the Companies Act
accepted.x: Mission Jagrook was launched on SEBI’s 38th Foundation Day.
accepted.tq: Discriminate among closely spaced milestone numbers.
accepted.sec: Investor protection - IEPF, SCORES, insider trading and PFUTP

accepted.s: The campaign titled ‘SEBI vs SCAM’ primarily belongs to which area?
accepted.x: SEBI vs SCAM is an investor-awareness campaign intended to support protection of investors in the securities market.
accepted.tq: Recognise the purpose of a named regulatory campaign rather than its institutional name alone.
accepted.sec: Investor protection - IEPF, SCORES, insider trading and PFUTP

accepted.s: The Forward Markets Commission (FMC) regulated commodity futures under which legislation?
accepted.x: The FMC regulated commodity futures under the Forward Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1952.
accepted.tq: Link the regulator with its governing legislation and avoid statutory-name swaps.
accepted.sec: Commodity market regulation - Forward Markets Commission

accepted.s: In which year was the Forward Markets Commission merged with SEBI?
accepted.x: The Forward Markets Commission was merged with SEBI in 2015.
accepted.tq: Use the institution’s transition year as the decisive clue.
accepted.sec: Commodity market regulation - Forward Markets Commission

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the consequences of the FMC-SEBI merger:
1. Brokers were allowed to participate in commodity derivatives.
2. NSE and BSE were allowed to participate in commodity derivatives.
3. Foreign Portfolio Investors were allowed in commodity derivatives.
4. Category III Alternative Investment Funds were allowed.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Following the merger, brokers, NSE, BSE, FPIs and Category III AIFs were allowed in commodity derivatives.
accepted.tq: Check whether the complete set of eligible participants is covered.
accepted.sec: Commodity market regulation - Forward Markets Commission

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched with the post-merger commodity-derivatives framework?
o: NSE and BSE — allowed in commodity derivatives
Category I AIFs — specifically allowed under the stated framework
accepted.x: The stated framework specifically allowed Category III AIFs, not Category I AIFs. Brokers, NSE and BSE, and FPIs were also allowed in commodity derivatives.
accepted.tq: Find the altered category in a list of otherwise correctly stated participants.
accepted.sec: Commodity market regulation - Forward Markets Commission

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. Enactment of the Forward Contracts (Regulation) Act
B. Merger of the Forward Markets Commission with SEBI
C. Launch of the SEBI vs SCAM campaign
D. Launch of Mission Jagrook
accepted.x: The Forward Contracts (Regulation) Act dates to 1952, the FMC-SEBI merger occurred in 2015, and the campaign and Mission Jagrook are later initiatives, with Mission Jagrook linked to SEBI’s 38th Foundation Day.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest statutory event first, then place the institutional merger and later initiatives.
accepted.sec: Commodity market regulation - Forward Markets Commission

accepted.s: The SEBI-NSE settlement of ₹1,492 crore was associated with the closure of which matter?
o: The merger of NSE and BSE
accepted.x: The ₹1,492 crore SEBI-NSE settlement closed the co-location case.
accepted.tq: Match a distinctive monetary figure with the regulatory matter to which it relates.

accepted.s: The SEBI-NSE settlement involving ₹1,492 crore was reported as closing the co-location case in:
accepted.x: The settlement was reported on 4 September 2026 as closing the co-location case.
accepted.tq: Combine the amount, event and date instead of relying on the amount alone.

accepted.s: Which institutions jointly conducted an SME IPO awareness programme in Vijayawada?
o: AP MSME Development Corporation and NSE
Ministry of Finance and IEPF Authority
accepted.x: The AP MSME Development Corporation and NSE jointly conducted the SME IPO awareness programme in Vijayawada.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct institutional partnership in an Andhra Pradesh-specific application.

accepted.s: The SME IPO awareness programme conducted in Vijayawada by the AP MSME Development Corporation and NSE was reported in which month and year?
accepted.x: The programme was reported on 10 May 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the precise month and year of a state-specific financial-awareness initiative.

accepted.s: As of December 2025, which of the following correctly represents the reported scale of investor participation?
o: 21.6 lakh demat accounts and 5.9 lakh mutual fund investors
5.9 crore demat accounts and 21.6 crore mutual fund investors
2.16 crore demat accounts and 59 crore mutual fund investors
21.6 crore demat accounts and 5.9 crore mutual fund investors
accepted.x: The reported figures for December 2025 were 21.6 crore demat accounts and 5.9 crore mutual fund investors.
accepted.tq: Keep the two figures attached to their correct categories and units.

accepted.s: Which criticism has been raised regarding the SMC?
o: It may transfer all securities regulation to the RBI
It may abolish investor protection mechanisms
It may prevent the operation of commodity derivatives
It may over-centralise power in SEBI
accepted.x: The criticism is that the SMC may over-centralise power in SEBI.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a criticism about institutional concentration from claims about abolition or transfer of powers.
